body:
**Supersedes #56** (`fix/m41-9-big-number-format` @ a08d196). A new branch off 1eca759 (#56's QA4 commit) with no force-push. #56's two follow-up commits are cherry-picked with `-x` (67238c2 → 078e68c, a08d196 → d646f1a), and three new commits sit on top. Once this lands, #56 can be closed.

**DO NOT MERGE** until HoE review, CCR, UI QA and Art sign-off on this SHA. HoE merges.

The UX-M1/M2/M3/M5 Art Minors are in a separate one-area PR, `fix/m41-9-ux-minors` (sibling, off main). UX-M4, the Best buy chip, is in #62.

## Spec sources
- `art-ux/number-format-big.md` (QA4-3 ruling 2026-10-19 09:45 §1–§7, and the "Rulings 2026-10-19 10:10" block, i.e. Art's 10:06 answers on #56)
- `art-ux/number-pop-spec.md` (pops are abbreviated)
- QA4-1/2/3 (UI QA), `product/farm/frozen/m4a-spec.v1.24.md` (unchanged here)

## Changes
- **1eca759** (from #56): QA4-1/2/3. Data-driven SUFFIXES K..Dc, scientific from 1e36 at 3 s.f., NBSP before unit words, floored Sell / Sell-all labels.
- **078e68c** (cherry-pick of 67238c2): the Art rulings on #56.
  - `spellShort` spells out Qa and above only, in aria and the live region only. K–T aria and `#live` are byte-identical to main (`liveText()`).
  - Visible `fmtMoneyExact` (coin pops, +$ floaters, Thanks chip) uses the compact form from $1e15 (`$1.2Qa`).
  - New `fmtMoneyAria` for order-row and Sell aria.
- **d646f1a** (cherry-pick of a08d196): `scripts/m41-9-bignum-shots.mjs`.
- **77911cb**: `tests/m41-9-art-rulings.test.ts` pins each of the five rulings by name (R1–R5). The shots script writes to `/workspace/wt-ui-shots/m41-9-<sha7>/` (argv or default, and the path must end in `-<sha7>`). The `OUT` env override is removed. It also adds an explicit order-card `'eggs'` word check and requires the ≥$1e15 pop to read `+$1.2Qa`.
- **9b6fc4a**: QA4-1 fix. The NBSP alone did not stop the "eggs" drop. Shots at 77911cb showed `.egg` ellipsized to 0–22 px at 360/375/390/1280 in all three engines for $999.9Dc / 1.23e36 / 1.00e36, because it is the only shrinkable flex item on the card line.
  - `OrderList.syncLineFit()` steps an overflowing card line down from 16 px to 14 px, then to 12 px with −0.02em tracking. Count and $ stay whole (Art's rc1 rule), and so does "eggs" (§4).
  - Only overflowing cards change. The fit re-runs only when the line text or card width changes. The old `.egg` ellipsis stays as the last resort.
  - In the shots script, the Sell button is now scored on its text staying inside the border box. Firefox `scrollWidth` excludes the border: it reported 93 vs 91 with the text 9.9 px from each edge, so nothing was visually clipped. Elements inside a closed sheet are logged as hidden and not scored.

## ACs → tests
| AC / ruling | Test |
|---|---|
| R1: compact money 1 decimal; counts and plain money 2 decimals under 10× | `m41-9-art-rulings` "R1 …" (3 tests, every tier K..Dc; K–T vs frozen dd223f5 formatter) |
| R2: exactly 1e36 → `1.00e36` | `m41-9-art-rulings` "R2" (fmtCount, Floor, fmtMoney, Floor, Short, Preview, Exact; Dc 999.95 roll-up) |
| R3: only Qa+ spelled, only aria/live; K–T byte-identical (`$1M, 13K eggs`) | `m41-9-art-rulings` "R3" (3 tests) + `m41-9-big-number` golden identity 0..1e15 vs `fixtures/format-dd223f5.ts` / `orders-dd223f5.ts` |
| R4: visible pops/floaters never spelled (`$1.2Qa`) | `m41-9-art-rulings` "R4" (1e15..1e40 sweep; app.ts call sites pinned) + browser: Sell tap at 1.2e15 dollars → floater `+$1.2Qa` (12/12 engine×width) |
| R5: Sell floor | `m41-9-art-rulings` "R5" (floored values never exceed n, 1e3..1e38) + `m41-9-big-number` QA4-2 |
| QA4-1: 'eggs' never dropped | `m41-9-art-rulings` "QA4-1" (CSS + wiring) + browser: order card `.egg` = "eggs", not ellipsized, 24/24 per engine |
| QA4-3 §6: $999.9Dc / $1.23e36 fit at 360 everywhere | browser: money pill, eggs counter, Sell, Sell all, upgrade cost, order card at 360/375/390/1280 × 3 engines: all ok |

## Local gates at 9b6fc4ab10debaf89354462e88698b9619c849c6 (CI is down)
- tsc --noEmit: PASS
- vitest (`--minWorkers=1 --maxWorkers=2`): **1016/1016**, 88 files, PASS
- `npm run build` + check-release-build: PASS
- `npm run build:html` + check-release-build: PASS
- check-globals (flock lane 1): PASS
- sync-economy --check: PASS (balance.json up to date)

## Shots
`/workspace/wt-ui-shots/m41-9-9b6fc4a/`, from `node scripts/m41-9-bignum-shots.mjs <engine>` on dist-qa `m3-rc1-pre+9b6fc4a`. One engine per run, in `flock … .browser-test.lock timeout 600`. Chromium, Firefox and WebKit: **all ok** (exit 0). Each engine writes a `manifest-<engine>.json` and the folder has a README.
- `dc-*` = $999.9Dc, `sci-*` = $1.23e36, `e36-*` = $1.00e36. Each state has market, upgrades and counter shots at w360/375/390/1280.
- `pop-1.2Qa-w*-<engine>.png`: the +$1.2Qa coin floater after a real Sell tap.
- The WebKit 360 order card shows "eggs" in `dc-market-w360-webkit.png`, `sci-market-w360-webkit.png` and `e36-market-w360-webkit.png` (fit2, "eggs" 26 px wide).
- The earlier run at 77911cb (`/workspace/wt-ui-shots/m41-9-77911cb/`, exit 1) is kept as the "before" for the eggs fix.

## Spec conflicts / notes
1. **§4 vs the shots.** §4 says the NBSP "fixes the WebKit eggs drop". It does not on its own: the drop is flex shrink on `.egg`, which happens in every engine. Fixed with the fit tiers.
2. **Art's rc1 rule vs §4.** The rc1 rule (`qa-rc1-bugs` test 3) is "count and $ never truncate; only .egg may ellipsize". §4 says "eggs never dropped". Both now hold down to 12 px with −0.02em tracking. The `.egg` ellipsis is kept only as the last resort past that (none of the shot states reach it). Art should confirm the 12 px / −0.02em floor for the card line, which no spec sets.
3. **§5 vs ruling 3.** §5 says spell every suffix in aria; ruling 3 (10:10) limits this PR to Qa+. I followed ruling 3. K–T spelling is a later a11y minor.
4. Visible `fmtMoneyExact` below $1e15 keeps main's full digit form (byte-identical). Only from $1e15 does it switch to the suffix form.
title: M4.1 M41-9: big-number format + Art rulings on #56 + QA4-1 eggs fit (supersedes #56)
